content: Figure FIGREF19 (b) shows the cases where the modality attention led to incorrect predictions. For example, the model predicts missing tokens HUUUGE and Shampooer incorrectly as named entities by amplifying misleading character-based contexts (capitalized first letters) or visual contexts (concert scenes, associated contexts of which often include named entities in the training dataset).
